scripts.dev:built: bun run --cwd ../web build && bun scripts/prepare-sidecar.mjs && tauri dev
scripts.build: bun run --cwd ../web build && bun scripts/prepare-sidecar.mjs && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.local.conf.json
scripts.typecheck: bun -e "await Bun.build({ entrypoints: ['scripts/prepare-sidecar.mjs'], target: 'bun', throw: true })"
scripts.build:release: bun run --cwd ../web build && bun scripts/prepare-sidecar.mjs && tauri build
